responses.text: Losing don't describe it. It's a massacre. Few more days and there won't be nothing left to lose.

topics.prompt: I heard you've been losing livestock.

responses.text: Well I don't know how you done it, but I do know how I can thank you. Please take this, compliments of Alice and myself.
And help yourself to anything in that freezer over yonder. We got more steaks in there than we'd be able to eat in a year.
Well we surely appreciate for what you done for us. Even without our stock, just having peace of mind means the world to us.
Take this, compliments of Alice and myself. We'd give you more if we could, knowing you risked your neck for us.

topics.prompt: No one is going to attack your corral from now on.

responses.text: Well don't worry yourself too much over it. We'll get by.
We'd be grateful. Especially if you find 'em before they get my whole stock. But don't go getting yourself killed over it.
Alice and I'll find a way to make do. Always have.

topics.prompt: I'll see if I can catch whoever's responsible.

responses.text: Every night around midnight Alice and I'll wake up to some crazy hollering and gun shots. You'd think the world was ending all over again.
But it's just one animal each night. They don't take it or carve it up or nothing. Just leave it there, all full of holes.

topics.prompt: Tell me what you know about the attacks.

responses.text: Oh, I tend to my ranch, that's about it. Alice'll tell you. I don't get out a whole lot.

topics.prompt: What do you do here in Novac?

responses.text: You seen Alice? Ain't like her to be gone this long.

Find anything?
Things treating you all right?
Well, to be honest with you, I don't really know them two as well as I might.
I remember she had an edge about her, like she'd rather be someplace else. This kind of life ain't for everyone, that's for darn sure.

topics.prompt: What can you tell me about Boone's wife?

responses.text: You sure seem worked up about something. I suppose I can hear you out.

responses.text: Can't say as I have, but we usually keep to ourselves down here. You might have more luck up by the motel.
